text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Wow, the Beast's Successor killed it<n>again!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Her build and skills are prettydifferent from Maruzensky's, but... Idon't know what it is, but she has aspark of something I can't take myeyes off of!

With Maruzensky gone, she might be<n>the only one
to bring some fire to the<n>Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Child in the Stands
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wondeeeer! You were<n>awesome in the
Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Child in the Stands
text_block_list.text:
The way you powered straight to the<n>goal was so,
so, SO cool!

text_block_list.name: Child in the Stands
text_block_list.text:
Dad! Hey, Dad! I wanna come back<n>and see the
next race!

text_block_list.name: Seasoned Fan
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh... I see. You're a full-blown<n>fan of hers
now, are you?

text_block_list.name: Child in the Stands
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I love Grass Wonder! I can't<n>wait to see how
she's gonna run<n>next time!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder, huh...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I wouldn't claim it a perfect<n>run, but I
have no regrets to speak of.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I demonstrated who I am at this<n>moment in time.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
All I can do is press on, and show<n>who I will
become.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That's exactly it!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello there, El... I thought you<n>might pay me a
visit.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously! Of course I'd come to<n>see your
race!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And now I'm positively certain<n>without a doubt!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I can't take on the world if I don't<n>beat you first,
Grass Wonder!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm givin' you an official<n>challenge!
Face me, Grass!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: At the Mainichi Okan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The Mainichi Okan... Isn't that a G2<n>race? I would
have thought you'd<n>pick something more
grandiose.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No, this year's Mainichi Okan is<n>special! The
Otherworldly<n>Front-Runner will be there!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: You know who that is, right? Silence<n>Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Silence Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka is an Umamusume<n>who's a little
older than Grass<n>Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's got a distinctive runaway style,<n>where she
takes a huge lead upfront<n>and doesn't let anyone
catch up.<n>She's the talk of the racing scene.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Interesting. This could turn out to be a<n>very
important race.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Right?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The Marvelous Front Runner, Silence<n>Suzuka! The
Brazen Blue Ogre, Grass<n>Wonder! And the World's
Strongest<n>Racer, me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The time: this fall! The place: Fuchu!<n>The
occasion: the Mainichi Okan! You<n>can't say no,
Grass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My eyes remain fixed on the<n>top—without
reservation, without<n>digression. I am making my
way<n>forward, step by step.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Should something block my path, I will<n>overcome it,
no matter what or who it<n>is.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That includes you, El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Excelente!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Welp, no reason to stand here<n>dawdlin' any longer.
It's time to train,<n>train, train!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Adiós!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ah. Wait a moment, El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I was taken aback during the<n>moment... but who do
you think<n>you're calling an ogre, hm?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Eeegh! My tail! Ow, ow, OWWW!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grass, El... you both really are<n>something else.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Even today, I just...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You raced well, Spe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzuka?! Whoa! You came today?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I happened to be close by and<n>remembered
you were racing.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wow... Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But I didn't put up a very good show,<n>did I? Hehe...
I didn't stand a chance<n>against Grass out there.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That reminds me! Is it true you're<n>going to run
in the Mainichi Okan?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's on my agenda... Why do you<n>ask?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I heard Grass and El talking about<n>you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: They're both aiming for the Mainichi<n>Okan, too!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...! Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I see... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...? Um, Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh... Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
After seeing how Grass raced today,<n>I got a little
excited.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what new sights I'll see<n>when I run with
those two in my<n>wake...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah... I'm sorry to keep you. You must<n>be tired.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'll get going, then. See you at the<n>dorm, Spe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: S-sure... See you then.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Excited about... what she'll see?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Would she feel the same way if I was<n>racing
instead?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Especially after today. I didn't put up<n>much of a
fight against Grass at all...
